title: Trader must supply goods or services within agreed period
description: A trader must supply goods or services within the agreed period to avoid delay that may lead to a rise in price

content.what: must supply goods or services within the agreed period
limitations: delay beyond the period agreed to by a trader in supply of such goods or in providing the services which has led or is likely to lead to rise in the price

aliases: supply goods or services on time
